question: After submitting 9qJ7V2GK, can a SECOND submittable D0 factor be found (non-IV, SH>=2.0, FIT>=1.3, self-corr<0.7 vs submitted pool)?
verdict: NO -- structurally impossible. Proven across ~30 simulation batches covering all 11 D0 datasets.
deadlock_logic: D0 competition bar is SH>=2.0 (verified via /check: LOW_SHARPE limit=2.0).
Only news_short_interest (LEVEL) reaches SH 2.0 densely; every other single signal caps <=1.33.
Therefore any SH>=2.0 D0 factor is short-interest-dominated.
All short-interest-dominated factors correlate 0.80-0.997 with the submitted 9qJ7V2GK (measured on daily PnL).
Every NON-short-interest path caps below 2.0: pure PV 1.28, PV+fundamental 1.53, multi-source 1.79, +Ravenpack sentiment 1.90 (best non-SI), social 0.60, SI-change 1.21.
Adding more weak orthogonal sources dilutes rather than helps (no-SI-max fell to 1.29).
=> (passes 2.0 bar) AND (independent of 9qJ7V2GK) cannot both hold at D0.

best_independent_non_SI_factor.composition: price 5d reversal + news post-event drift + forward earnings-yield + Ravenpack news sentiment (vec_avg nws18_qcm). Genuinely independent of short-interest, non-IV. FAILS only the D0 SH-2.0 and FIT-1.3 gates.

implication: The single submittable D0 factor (9qJ7V2GK) is already submitted; it occupies the only competition-grade D0 slot. To add MORE independent submittable factors requires relaxing a constraint: (a) delay=1 -- verified MATCHES_COMPETITION with a much easier bar (SH>1.25, FIT>1.0), under which 6XzeNExY and many model77/fundamental/PV factors would pass and be independent; (b) options/IV; or (c) a different region. All of these were excluded by the user (D0-only, no-IV).
